paras: Lioscincus steindachneri, also known commonly as the white-lipped forest skink or Steindachner's ground skink, is a species of lizard in the family Scincidae. The species is endemic to New Caledonia.
The specific name, steindachneri, is in honor of Austrian herpetologist Franz Steindachner.
The preferred natural habitat of L. steindachneri is moist forest, at altitudes of 200–1,110 m (660–3,640 ft).
The mode of reproduction of L. steindachneri is unknown. It may be oviparous or viviparous.
